title: Apply taste-skill UI/UX redesign to Wrapper Registry
body: ## Summary Redesigns the Confidential Wrapper Registry web app using principles from [taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill) (redesign-existing-projects + cold dark developer-tool direction). ## Design changes - **Visual language:** Replaced warm editorial cream palette with a cold dark tech theme (navy base, sky accent, subtle mesh + noise texture) - **Typography:** Outfit (display) + DM Sans (body) + JetBrains Mono (data) - **Navigation:** Floating glass pill header with segmented nav chips - **Motion & states:** Page enter animation, button press feedback, focus rings, `prefers-reduced-motion` support ## UX improvements - Skeleton loaders while registry pairs fetch - Clickable table rows (keyboard accessible) + copy-address buttons - Search clear control, filter result count, composed empty state with reset - Pair detail workflow step indicators, Max buttons for wrap/unwrap amounts - Per-token mint loading state on faucet, wallet network status dot - Skip-to-content link, favicon, improved status `role` for errors ## Demo ## Test plan - [x] `pnpm build:web` passes - [x] Manual browser walkthrough of Registry, Faucet, and Pair detail pages
